subject: CSA control ancestry & evidence verification — ArgoFin scope
messages:
From: Dana Cole <dana.cole@argofin.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: security@argofin.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ArgoFin CSA follow-up — control ancestry and sample artifacts

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick walk-through last week. As we prepare our CSA review board, the reviewers asked for two specific clarifications before we can accept your CAIQ responses: 

1) Control ancestry (they want a short narrative + pointers showing how higher-level CSA controls map down to runtime artifacts and logs).
2) A 7-day log sample (timeboxed) and a short explanation of what will be submitted as evidence for the following controls: CCM-API-3, CCM-APP-2, CCM-CR-4.

Can you confirm who on your side owns each control and whether you can provide the timeboxed KV/log archive by next Wednesday (2027-04-14)? We expect the archive to be a small zip with metadata describing sampling windows (CSV) and a readme.

We have a tight audit window — appreciate any acceleration you can do.

Thanks,
Dana
Dana Cole
Security Manager, ArgoFin
[Attachment: ArgoFin-CSA-ask.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Dana Cole <dana.cole@argofin.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ArgoFin CSA follow-up — control ancestry and sample artifacts

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear ask.

Short answers up front: we can provide the 7-day KV/log sample and an ancestry narrative. Below is the plan and owners; we’ll deliver the zip and the annotated mapping by 2027-04-13 EOD to give you a day buffer.

Owners & deliverables
- CCM-API-3 (API auth + rate-limiting): Kimberly Park — will deliver a short narrative + API gateway logs sample.
- CCM-APP-2 (Application configuration + runtime controls): Marissa Cole — will provide config snapshot + runtime trace and README.
- CCM-CR-4 (Change control for inference model revisions): Priya Natarajan — will include commit history pointers and deployment runbook snippet.

Requested artifact format (what we will include in the zip)
- logs/: KV cache samples and API gateway lines (CSV snippets)
- manifests/: config snapshots and commit refs (YAML/TXT)
- metadata.csv: sampling window, environment, record counts
- README.md: mapping of each CRA control to artifacts and chain of custody notes

Attachments referenced:
- Will attach an annotated CAIQ answers sheet (caiq-answers-diff-annotated.xlsx) showing which evidence file corresponds to each control row.
- Sample logs will be pseudonymized and time-windowed; they will not contain PII.

Let me know if the reviewers need a different sampling window (e.g., last 30 days) or if they need signed attestations from control owners.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: caiq-answers-diff-annotated.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Dana Cole <dana.cole@argofin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ArgoFin CSA follow-up — control ancestry and sample artifacts

Thanks Sofia. Quick operational notes from my side:

- I’ll extract API gateway logs for the window 2027-03-28 to 2027-04-03 and redact client tokens. Expected CSV size ~3.2MB (small). I’ll include a short parser script and a manifest showing which rows were sampled.
- Marissa and Priya, I’ll need the control-ownership roster updated (CSV) so the README can reference individual owner attestations.

Marissa: can you confirm the config snapshot path you plan to include? I want to make sure we include the runtime flags that map to CCM-APP-2.

ETA: I can do the log extract and upload to the drive link Sofia provided by 2027-04-12 AM. I’ll also attach kv-log-sample-202703.zip to the final package.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: control-ownership-roster.csv (csv)]

From: Dana Cole <dana.cole@argofin.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ArgoFin CSA follow-up — control ancestry and sample artifacts

Sofia / team — this looks great, thank you. The ArgoFin review board is OK with the proposed 7-day window; the only ask is that we get a short chain-of-custody note that explains how the sample was extracted and who signed off on it.

If you can include that in README.md and drop the package to the Drive link by 2027-04-13 EOD, we should be able to close the evidence loop next week.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Dana
Dana Cole
Security Manager, ArgoFin
